## Public-release checklist

- [ ] No credentials, signed URLs, personal paths, private inputs, model weights, or generated fixtures were added
- [ ] New claims link to reproducible evidence and identify the tested environment
- [ ] Third-party code or assets include provenance and compatible terms
- [ ] Documentation and changelog were updated when behavior changed
